ORAL ORDER Learned advocate Ms. Shaili A. Kapadia for the respondent no.3 and learned APP Mr. Rutvij Oza for the respondent no. 1-State have submitted that this dispute would fall under Sections 26, 27,
3(1)(zx) and Section 51 Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 and regulation 2.1.5 of Food Safety and Standard (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations 2011.

sentences.text: Hence, settlement between the parties is not admissible.
Thus, they have requested to place this matter before the regular court for adjudication on its merits.
On their request, let the matter be placed before the regular court.
